name: ICS 45C
fullTitle: Programming in C/C++ as a Second Language

en-US.heroPrimary: ICS 45C is UCI's C++ programming course, focused on how programs are designed, built, debugged, and reasoned about in a lower-level language.
en-US.heroSecondary: This page collects week-by-week notes for classmates who want a structured review of course concepts such as C++ syntax, program structure, testing, and problem solving.
en-US.readerDescription: This page presents {course}{weekPhrase} notes in a structured reading format so you can review syntax, program structure, testing, and problem solving week by week. The path below takes you back to Notes, Course Notes, the course page, or this note file. Hover over the ≡ icon on the right side to open the Table of Contents.
